title_en: Fall 2026 Master's and Doctoral Thesis Examination Public Presentation Schedule
summary: The department has published the Fall 2026 public presentation schedules for master's thesis examinations and doctoral preliminary (first-round) examinations in two attached files, which may be changed at any time. Attendees, including students taking the Master's/Doctoral Seminar, must check the attached files again on the day of each examination, as times and venues may change. The attachments were not read, so the actual dates, times and rooms must be taken from the attached PDF files in the original notice.
applies_to: Anyone attending the Fall 2026 master's thesis examination or doctoral preliminary examination public presentations, including students taking the Master's/Doctoral Seminar (석박사세미나). The notice does not state who else must attend or whether attendance is mandatory.
conditions: The schedules in the attached files may be changed at any time, including times and venues.
Attendees must check the attached files again on the day of the examination.
steps: Open the attached files in the original notice: "2026-2학기 석사 심사 일정.pdf" (master's examination schedule) and "2026-2학기 박사 초심 일정.pdf" (doctoral preliminary examination schedule). Their content was not read for this translation.
Find the date, time and venue of each presentation you need to attend.
On the day of the examination, check the attached files again for any changes to the time or venue.
For questions, contact the department office (Building 301, Room 319); the contact details are in the original notice.
translation:
★(Subject to change at any time) Fall 2026 Master's/Doctoral Thesis Examination Public Presentation Schedule

We announce the public presentation schedule for master's and doctoral thesis examinations for Fall 2026.

1. Master's public presentation schedule
- See the attached file (the content may change at any time).

2. Doctoral public presentation (preliminary examination [초심]) schedule
- See the attached file (the content may change at any time).

3. Notes
- The public presentation schedule (attached files) is updated from time to time. Because times, venues and other details may change, attendees, including students taking the Master's/Doctoral Seminar [석박사세미나], must check the attached files again on the day of the examination.

4. Inquiries
- Department office (Building 301, Room 319). The staff member's name, phone number and email are given in the original notice.

Attachments (2):
- 2026-2학기 박사 초심 일정.pdf (Fall 2026 doctoral preliminary examination schedule, 151 KB)
- 2026-2학기 석사 심사 일정.pdf (Fall 2026 master's examination schedule, 285 KB)

[Note: The content of the attached files was not read for this translation.]
